shared_elements: carved/incised figures on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces bear carved figures including animals in profile, but A is dominated by boats with rows of crew strokes, small stick-like human figures and scattered abstract marks spread flatly across a broad panel, while B shows a single large quadruped in profile above a second reptilian/feline creature on a narrow upright slab. Beyond the generic 'profile animal' there is no shared motif, no comparable relationship between figures, and A's linear stick-figure convention differs from B's raised relief with modelled body mass.
